reproduction.rationale: Selected original endpoint: Original NEDS Table 1 and Table 10 joint neural encoding and behavioral decoding performance: all five encoding masks (all behavior, choice, block, wheel and whisker) and all four behavioral targets, on all 74 original pretraining sessions and all ten original held-out sessions using the original target-session 70/10/20 protocol. Preserve every one of the nine source endpoints and the applicable original author comparators; no mixed-unit scalar or convenient cohort subset. Matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code delivery requires authentic source data/code manifests, operator-held final labels/reference, exact evaluator/runtime identity, source-specific access/resource budgets and exposure review. Authenticate historical ONE object revisions, eligible neurons/trials and exact original split identities; reconcile 2-Hz paper versus >5-Hz code eligibility. See access-conditions.v1.json; no hashes or results are invented.
